tracking_scope: Full stack before separation; first-stage booster afterward.

cargo_mass_kg.locator: TOTAL CARGO; includes 1530 kg pressurized cargo with packaging and 960 kg unpressurized cargo
cargo_mass_kg.scope: Cargo only, not total Dragon spacecraft launch mass.

separate_payload_fairing_mass_kg.scope: Dragon assembly replaces the generic satellite-plus-fairing model. Any spacecraft nosecone belongs to the supplied loaded assembly mass, not an additional 1700 kg satellite fairing.

required_input_basis: Verified CRS-10 total loaded assembly mass and CG not established. Inputs must include spacecraft, trunk, cargo and relevant launch hardware without double counting. Equivalent shape and CG must be sourced or explicitly assumed. No numeric defaults silently adopted.
inherited_parameters: Stage dry masses, propellant inventories, tank geometry and engine performance retain the mixed-source Falcon9Parameters profile; not verified CRS-10 measurements.
excluded_reference: The 21.08 m2 fairing-based Cd curve has not been validated for Dragon ascent; the temporary B model is unchanged pending Philipp's work.
